paragraphs: This section outlines the learning outcomes for the project, which focuses on developing a microcontroller-based system to monitor soil moisture and alert users when necessary. The system utilizes the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller, equipped with GPIO, ADC, Timers, UART peripherals, and specific pins.
bullets: Understand the hardware components used in the project.
Implement basic input/output operations using GPIO pins.
Utilize the ADC to measure soil moisture levels accurately.
Configure and use timers for periodic tasks like monitoring soil moisture or alerting users.
Develop a UART interface to send and receive data over USB, facilitating debugging and telemetry.
